sense: someone who acts or does business for another

terms.gloss: an agent, someone who manages affairs for another
terms.comment: Also a manager (see manager); Traupman forms modern agents with it, as itinerum prōcūrātor, travel agent.

terms.gloss: one who sells goods for another; a hawker

phrases.latin: is quī lēgitimē prōcūrātor dīcitur, omnium rērum ejus quī in Ītaliā nōn sit absitve reī pūblicae causā quasi quīdam paene dominus, hoc est aliēnī jūris vicārius
phrases.english: the man who is properly called an agent: for someone who is not in Italy, or is away on public business, he is almost a kind of owner of everything, that is, a deputy for another’s rights
